indications: BRINSUPRI is indicated for the treatment of non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis (NCFB) in adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.
contraindications: Recommended dosage: 10 mg or 25 mg orally once daily with or without food. ( 2.1 )
